paper_title: Prospects of nuclear-coupled-dark-matter detection via correlation spectroscopy of I2+ and Ca+
notes: Proposal/projection paper. Title 'Prospects of nuclear-coupled-dark-matter detection via correlation spectroscopy of I2+ and Ca+'. Abstract and Sec.V state the paper projects a few-orders-of-magnitude improvement in ULDM sensitivity; Fig.3 explicitly labels the thick red 'I2+/Ca+ (this work)' line as the projected constraint (dashed = projections). No new measured experimental exclusion is derived. Constraints shown for scalar d_g (Fig.3a) and axion 1/f_a (Fig.3b) are forecasts only. rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed in text. Reported as is_projection with no points.
